R-S(15,12,4) 码的生成矩阵是如何得到的？
由其生成多项式得到。
How is the vector m defined in terms of its components?
消息向量 m 由多少个字节构成？
消息向量 m 由 12 个字节构成。
在 GF(2^8) 中，使用多项式表达式和幂表达式进行加法运算的难易程度及原因分别是什么？
对于多项式表达式，加法是容易的，因为每项模 2 加即可。对于幂表达式，加法是困难的，因为需要将幂表达式转化为多项式表达式以实现加法，然后再转回幂表达式。
在 GF(2^8) 中，使用幂表达式和多项式表达式进行乘法运算的难易程度及处理方式分别是什么？
对于幂表达式，乘法是容易的，只需把指数模 255 加即可。对于多项式表达式，乘法较为困难，因为多项式相乘后会产生一个更高次多项式，然后需要按式 (C.24) 取模。
如何将 $\alpha$ 的多项式转化为 $\alpha$ 的幂表达式？
使用对数表（表 C.21）。
在生成或检验 CRC/R-S 监督码时，如何确定使用的初值？
需根据数据类型 (DT) 对应使用一个唯一的 CRC 或者 R-S 初值，其定义见表 C.22。
为什么最终生成的 CRC 监督码 C(x) 可能有两种形式？
因为根据不同的要求，最终生成的 CRC 码可能附加取反的操作。
How is I(x) defined in the provided equations?
在接收方进行 CRC 校验时，如何判断 DT 解码是否正确？
如果接收方正确解码 DT，则可以通过 CRC 校验，计算所得余数为零；如果接收方错误解码 DT，则无法通过 CRC 校验，计算所得余数不为零。
对于“1/2 编码率数据帧”，其 CRC/R-S 初值和初值有效比特数分别是多少？使用该初值有什么前提条件？
初值为 $087_{16}$，初值有效比特数为 9。使用该初值的前提条件是只有当 CRC-9 出现在突发内时才用。
What are the memory specifications and expansion capabilities of the device?
The device has 3 GB of RAM and 32 GB of eMMC ROM. It supports expansion up to 128 GB with a Micro SD card, though one line also mentions expansion up to 16 GB with a Micro SD card.
What are the megapixel specifications for the rear and front cameras of the PTC680?
The rear camera is 13 MP and the front camera is 5 MP.
What is the maximum loudness provided by the professional acoustic solutions in the PTC680 radio?
Up to 128 dB.
节点设备在定位功能方面有哪些要求？
节点设备应支持北斗定位，可支持 GPS 定位，并具备转发 PDT 移动台或其他设备定位信息的功能。
PDT节点设备的短消息格式应符合哪个国家标准的规定？
应符合 GB/T 34991-2017 的规定。
PDT节点设备中，72比特的卫星定位数据如何转换为语音帧嵌入？
将 72 比特的卫星定位数据转换为 128 比特，并分为 4 个 32 比特分别嵌入在 B、C、D 和 E 语音帧中。
What are the connectivity methods for remotely programming multi-mode radios and BWCs?
Multi-mode radios and BWCs can be programmed via WLAN, LTE, or by connecting them to the specified IDS.
How does the scope of control for a group administrator work in Device Management by Group?
The group administrator only controls devices in its own group.
What is the function of the Radio Alias setting?
The Radio Alias setting allows you to set an alias for the radio that can be viewed through the menu.
Which settings control whether a radio is allowed to initiate private, group, or all calls?
The settings are Initiate Private Call, Initiate Group Call, and Initiate All Call.
What are the capacity limits supported by the CPS-P3 dial rule for NPs, users, fleet groups, and hierarchical groups?

The CPS-P3 dial rule supports 479 NPs. Each NP contains up to 32,200 private call numbers, 7,000 fleet group call numbers, and 4,000 hierarchical group call numbers. This means CPS-P3 can support up to 15,423,800 users, 3,353,000 fleet groups, and 1,916,000 hierarchical groups.
How does the 'None' option affect the Radio ID (Conventional) configuration?
When set to None, the radio does not use a dial rule.
How does the Radio ID format differ between MPT1343 large fleet and CPSX system types?
For MPT1343 large fleet, the format is NP (3 digits) + FIN (4 digits) + UN (3 digits). For CPSX, the format is NP (3 digits) + FIN (2 digits) + UN (3 digits).
What is the scope of an All Call when 'All Call in Area' is enabled?
When enabled, the radio can initiate an All Call to all valid users in all base stations of the area that the radio is in.
Which call types are considered normal voice calls that can be preempted by a Pre-emptive Call?
Normal voice calls include Private Call, Group Call, and Broadcast Call. They refer to all calls except Emergency Call.
What is the effect of setting a Private Call Priority to Preemptive 1-3?
Calls with Preemptive 1-3 priority can forcibly disconnect calls of lower priorities.
How does the radio handle TX Request Priority levels regarding preemption?
There are three levels in ascending order: Low Priority, High Priority, and Pre-emptive Priority. Low Priority and High Priority are non-preemptive.
What happens when Broadcast Call Preferred is disabled?
The broadcast call will be established according to CoU.
What is the menu path to access the Roaming settings under Conventional mode?
The menu path is Conventional > Roam > Setting > Roaming.
How should the Emergency Type and Call To Follow be configured for digital emergency alarms, and what is the effect on microphone operation?

Set Emergency Type to Normal and set Emergency Group Call to the target ID of the emergency call. After enabling Call To Follow, you do not need to press PTT to send voice because the radio automatically opens the microphone.
What capability does a radio gain when the locating function is enabled?
When the locating function is enabled, a radio can upload its location to the control center, which can then manage and dispatch the radio.
What settings are required when Time Trigger or Distance Trigger is enabled for Location Report?
When Time Trigger or Distance Trigger is enabled, Report Time Interval or Report Distance Interval needs to be set.
What configuration step is necessary when Key Trigger is enabled for Location Report?
A button needs to be redefined to Location Report accordingly.
How is the Call Location function configured between the sending and receiving parties?
This function is configured at the receiving party, and the sending party needs to enable the Call with Location function at the same time.
How can a user configure a radio to quickly switch to a frequently used talk group?
The user can set the most frequently used talk group as the standby group in Talk Group Settings and redefine a button to quickly switch to that group.
What is the navigation path to configure DGNA?
Group Management > Settings > DGNA > DGNA
How does a radio determine when to detect neighbor cell signal strength after initial registration?

The radio detects the signal strength of neighbor cells broadcast by the system if the detected signal strength of the current cell is smaller than the cell re-selection threshold delivered by the system.
What are the three available priority cell use policies for radio registration?
The three policies are: Common mode, Immediate registration in priority cell, and Registration in priority cell only.
Under the 'Registration in priority cell only' policy, where is a radio allowed to register?
A radio can register only in a cell in the priority cell list and cannot register in a non-priority cell.
How does associating a folder with a fixed cell and scan list affect radio registration and scanning?

When a folder is switched, the radio registers in the cell associated with that folder, and the scan list associated with the folder automatically becomes the default scan list. This ensures radios participating in a call register in the same cell to properly adopt channel resources.
What are the two available dial modes for establishing a packet data connection?

The two available dial modes are Internal App Dial, where the radio's internal mechanism controls data transmission, and External PEI Dial, where an external device connects via a PEI interface to initiate and control the connection.
What are the functional limitations of a radio when its screen is locked?
A radio with a locked screen can only receive calls and take photos.
Which components are preserved during a Factory Data Reset?
During a Factory Data Reset, the OS software version, self-provided app version, and radio license are reserved.
双引号（“”）在文档格式规范中用于表示什么内容？
该符号表示软件界面控件名称，例如：单击“确定”。
符号【】在操作指引中代表哪类界面控件？
表示硬件界面控件名称，例如：按【PTT】键。
写频插件支持哪些类型的终端或设备？
支持多模终端、窄带 DMR 终端、窄带 TETRA 终端、窄带 PDT 终端和执法记录仪。
在步骤4中，应使用哪个用户通过Xftp工具上传文件？
应使用 root 用户。
执法记录仪需要使用哪个驱动程序包？
Windows 驱动程序包-libusb-win32 Ambarella Evaluation。
如何为设备开启收费功能？
需要上传对应许可证以开启该功能。在弹出的窗口中选择.zip格式的许可证文件，单击“打开”。
What sound settings can be configured for task download and execution notifications in IDS?
The notification sound can be set as voice, alert tone, or Off.
What are the steps to register machine code?
1. Click **Register** to access the window **IDS Registration**. 2. Enter **Name** and **Contact**. 3. Click **OK**.
What precaution should be taken regarding Admin Station when connecting a device to the User Client?
Do not run Admin Station on the same PC when connecting the device, otherwise the connection might fail.
What steps should be taken if device information does not display on the main page after connecting to the User Client?
Reconnect the data cable or reinstall the drive program.
LED 指示灯蓝色闪烁且每 1.5 秒闪烁一次代表什么状态？
已成功连接蓝牙设备。
How can you check the charging status when using a charger to charge the battery alone or attached to the radio?
You can learn about the charging status through the LED indicator on the charger. For details, refer to the label at the bottom of the charger.
How do you switch the radio to a specific mode such as Broadband or Repeater mode?
On the home screen, go to Menu > Mode. Select the desired mode, and then press the OK/Menu key.
What are the methods to select the standby group on the radio?
You can rotate the Channel Selector knob, or on the home screen, press the Left key or Right key.
What is the procedure to initiate a call on a digital channel?
Rotate the Channel Selector knob to select a digital channel, and then press and hold the Primary PTT key.
How do you initiate a call in Broadband & Narrowband mode from the Contacts menu?
Go to Menu > Contacts, select a contact, and then press and hold the Auxiliary PTT key.
终端LED指示灯显示红色常亮、红色快闪和绿色常亮分别代表什么充电状态？
红色常亮表示正在充电，红色快闪表示充电异常，绿色常亮表示已充满。
如何切换终端的工作模式以及开启自动切换功能？
手动切换可进入“工作模式”菜单选择，或按【切换工作模式】快捷键立即切换。开启自动切换功能可在“工作模式”菜单中开启“自动切换”，或按【自动切换工作模式】快捷键，终端将根据信号强度切换工作模式。
如何在待机界面将某个联系人设置为默认并自动切换至其所在组群？
在待机界面按【组群】键进入组群列表，按【上移】/【下移】键选择所需组群，在所选组群中选择联系人并将该联系人设置为默认，终端会自动切换至该组群。
通过按键或旋钮选择联系人时，默认是在什么范围内切换？若需跨组群切换需满足什么条件？
默认在当前组群内切换。若开启了跨组群切换，则可以跨组群切换联系人。
公共图标中，电池电量显示越满代表什么状态？
电池电量越足。
专网图标在常规模式下显示 D 和 R 分别代表什么含义？
D 代表直通，R 代表中转。
LED1 指示灯红色闪烁（每 0.2 秒闪烁一次）代表什么状态？
在集群模式下表示随机接入或接收到警报。
在常规模式下进行一键呼叫业务时，操作步骤是什么？
需在按【一键呼叫】快捷键后再按【PTT】键发起呼叫。
当终端呼叫排队且经销商开启了拆线功能时，如何取消呼叫排队？
挂机可以取消呼叫排队，结束本次呼叫。
如何设置提示音音量，且音量级别与声音大小的关系是什么？
开启响铃功能后，选择“设置 > 提示音音量”进行设置。提示音级别越大，音量越大。
在嘈杂环境中开启噪声消除和 AGC 功能分别有什么作用？
开启噪声消除后，终端发射语音时会自动过滤环境噪声，使接收方听到更清晰的语音。开启 AGC（自动增益控制）可以对输出语音部分进行增益控制，使输出信号强度保持在一定范围内，从而在嘈杂环境下获得稳定的语音效果。
终端在哪些操作下会触发语音播报功能？
终端在以下操作时会语音播报当前信道号或电量值：旋转旋钮切换信道或联系人、电池电量低、按可编程按键触发对应的功能。
如何在待机界面快速开启WLAN或移动数据？
在待机界面按【上移】键打开控制中心，选择并开启WLAN或移动数据。
终端成功连接蓝牙设备后，显示屏会显示什么提示？连接成功的设备保存在哪里？
显示屏显示“蓝牙已连接”，表示终端已成功连接蓝牙设备。连接成功的蓝牙设备自动保存在已配设备列表中。
在通话过程中，接收方要显示发起方的位置信息，双方终端分别需要开启什么功能？
发起方需开启“语音携带定位”功能，接收方需开启“显示讲话方位置”功能。
“仅鸣笛”和“警报鸣笛”这两种报警类型在终端表现和控制中心接收情况上有什么区别？
“仅鸣笛”时，终端发出尖锐报警音并显示图标，但控制中心不会接收到报警信号；“警报鸣笛”时，终端同样发出尖锐报警音并显示图标，但会向控制中心发送报警信号。
在紧急呼叫或警报呼叫过程中，如果开启了自动紧急呼叫功能，如何发起讲话？当自动呼叫次数超限后该如何操作？
若开启了自动紧急呼叫功能，无需按住【PTT】键即可讲话。当自动紧急呼叫次数超过经销商预设的次数时，如需再次发起紧急呼叫，可按住【PTT】键。
什么是倒放功能？触发该功能后如何退出紧急报警模式？
倒放是指当终端倾斜角度大于预设角度或保持相对静止（或匀速运动）超过预设时间后，终端自动进入紧急报警模式。移动或扶正终端可退出紧急报警。
如何调节显示屏的亮度？
可以通过两种方式调节亮度：1. 进入设置选择“亮度”，设置亮度等级，等级越大屏幕越亮；2. 在待机界面按【上移】键打开控制中心，再按【左移】键或【右移】键调节亮度。
在常规模式下使用一键呼叫/消息功能发起呼叫时，具体的操作步骤是什么？
需先按【一键呼叫/消息】快捷键，然后再按【PTT】键。
本产品接触液体后或接口未干燥时，应如何正确进行干燥处理？
请使用干净的软布将产品表面及所有沾水区域彻底擦干，然后将设备放置在通风良好的干燥区域。
在处理进水的本产品时，有哪些禁止的操作行为？
禁止开机、连接外部配件或充电；禁止使用微波炉、吹风机热风等外部热源进行干燥；禁止将棉签或纸巾等塞入接口。
为了保证电池性能并延长使用寿命，充电时需要遵守哪些规范？
需使用原装充电器；充电前请先关闭产品；请勿在开机状态下充电，也不要在电池充电过程中使用本产品。
电池充电的环境温度范围是多少？
在使用中性洗涤剂清洁产品时，有哪些具体的操作禁忌和注意事项？
不要将中性洗涤剂直接喷洒在本产品上。应将适量中性洗涤剂喷洒在干净的无线软布上，清洁前拧干多余溶液，以防止液体进入产品内部。清洁时需小心，避免将液体和污垢推入按键缝隙、扬声器、接口处及其他开口中。
对本产品进行消毒时，推荐的消毒剂浓度是多少？操作时应如何防止液体进入内部？
推荐使用浓度不少于 70% 的外用酒精。操作时，应用干净的无线软布蘸取酒精，并在消毒前确保拧干多余的溶液，以防止溶液进入产品内部。此外，不要将消毒剂直接喷洒在产品上。
PTC680/PDC680设备在音频输出和嘈杂环境下的通话表现有哪些技术支撑？
该设备采用前音腔扩展专利技术及专业声学设计，音频响度最高可达128dB；同时结合多麦降噪、回声消除和防风噪技术，确保在嘈杂环境下声音仍然响亮清晰。
PTC680/PDC680支持哪些定位系统和技术以满足不同环境的定位需求？
该设备支持GPS、北斗、伽利略、格洛纳斯和QZSS以实现快速精准定位；同时使用基站或WLAN定位技术辅助定位，满足用户在室内、地下等环境下的定位需求。
PTC680/PDC680在视频录制和证据管理方面提供了哪些功能？
设备支持视频防抖功能，可在运动状态下录制稳定清晰的视频；专为执法录像打造DECam APP，配合DEM可为电子证据提供安全有序管理。
What tool is required to release the nut when removing the smart knob assembly?
A socket wrench is required to release the nut.
What are the physical dimensions of the device when equipped with a battery but without an antenna?
The dimensions are 145.32 mm x 60 mm x 30.1 mm.
What is the specified weight of the device including the battery and antenna?
The weight is 332 ± 5 g.
Which positioning systems does the device support?
The device supports GPS, BDS, GLONASS, Galileo, and QZSS.
What are the audio power ratings for the device?
The rated audio power is 1 W@16 ohms, and the maximum audio power is 2 W.
What are the resolution and color depth specifications for the 3.6-inch main screen?
The 3.6-inch main screen has a resolution of 1280 × 720 pixels and a color depth of 24 bits.
What is the maximum supported capacity for the TF card and how much RAM does the device have?
The device has 4 GB of RAM and supports a TF card with a maximum capacity of 256 GB.
What are the specifications for the rear and front cameras?
The rear camera is 13 MP with auto focus, and the front camera is 8 MP with fixed focus.
What is the rated operating voltage of the radio and which components does this specific voltage power?
The rated operating voltage of the radio is 7.7 V. This power supply powers the RF PA and the audio PA.
How is the NFC powered, starting from the 3V8D supply?
The 3V8D powers the motor and is then converted to the 3V6D through the U2013 to power the NFC.
How does the GPS module communicate with the DSP and AP?
The GPS module communicates with the DSP and AP through the UART.
How does the system determine an emergency power-on and what action does it take?
When the EMERGENCY signal is at low level, the system determines that the power-on is an emergency power-on and sends out narrowband alarm information, which is configured by the customer.
What is the downlink voice signal path for call modes other than BT calls?
Except for BT calls, downlink voice signals go to the external audio codec (U3003) for processing, then to the audio amplifier (U3006) for amplification, and finally to the speaker or earpiece.
How does the VCO obtain different output frequencies?
The VCO obtains different output frequencies by changing the control voltage (CV voltage) of the varactor.
Which interfaces does the Android Platform use to connect to the 3.6-inch LCD display and the touchscreen?
The Android Platform connects to the 3.6-inch LCD display through the MIPI interface and to the touchscreen through the I2C interface.
How does the Android Platform initialize and control the front and rear cameras, and what interface is used for data connection?
The Android Platform connects to the front and rear cameras through the 4/4-lane MIPI interface. It initializes and controls the operation of the cameras through the I2C interface.
What is the behavior of the moisture detection chip when a data cable is connected to the USB Type-C port?

When a data cable is connected to the USB Type-C port, the moisture detection chip checks for moisture every 5 seconds. If water ingress is detected, the radio displays a water ingress alert on the screen and stops charging.
How are downlink voice signals processed for non-BT call modes before reaching the speaker or earpiece?

Except for BT calls, downlink voice signals go to the WB audio codec (U2503) and external audio codec (U3003) for processing, then to the audio amplifier (U3006) for amplification, and finally to the speaker or earpiece.
What impedance value should be measured with a multimeter at TP3001 and TP3002 when checking speaker contact issues?
The impedance measured with a multimeter at TP3001 and TP3002 is 16 ohms.
What are the normal voltage readings for TP_VDD and TP_VDDIO in the touchscreen circuit?
The voltage is 3V at TP_VDD and 1.8 V at TP_VDDIO.
How does the SIM card signal level behave during a call when measured with an oscilloscope?
The SIM card signal level jumps between 0 V and 1.8 V or 0 V and 3 V during a call.
Which SEL option combination defines the USB primary mode for the radio?
The USB primary mode for the radio is defined by SEL1_OPT = 0, SEL2_OPT = 1, and SEL3_OPT = 0.
What software is required to tune the radio after reassembling it?
The Tuner software is required to tune the radio after reassembling it.
What must be done after confirming settings for one channel to ensure they are saved to the radio?
You must switch to the next channel; otherwise, the settings will not be saved to the radio.
In Device Manager, what visual indicator marks the ADB Interface before the driver is updated?
An exclamation mark.
双模终端中NB侧和RoIP侧在处理相同业务时采用什么策略？
NB侧和RoIP侧都采用相同的策略。
在半双工抢话权场景下，双模终端以哪一侧的策略为主？
以NB侧的策略为主，RoIP侧遵从相同的策略。
双模终端使用半双工抢话权功能的前提条件是什么？
只有开启了半双工抢话权时才能使用。
为解决AP休眠导致IP链接断开的问题，终端在RoIP或多媒体业务连接状态下应采取什么措施？
在RoIP连接状态或多媒体业务连接状态时，AP需保持网络唤醒以解决休眠断开IP链接的问题。需要注意的是，这里的网络唤醒指的是保持网络连接活跃，而不是指AP亮屏。
在Alt2场景中，当BB先返回Busy随后返回Can Switch时，终端的选网行为及结果是什么？
终端会重新选网，但选网结果没有变化，随后终端直接切换到NB网络。
当NB返回Busy后，若繁忙过后NB返回Can Switch且终端重新选网的结果没有变化，终端将如何操作？
终端直接切换到BB网络。
当RoIP和NB均开启时，若用户正在RoIP登记且业务进行中，关闭RoIP会导致哪些业务结束？
会结束当前ROIP业务和MMS业务。
在CPS-P3 R1.0和R1.5系统中，RoIP功能是在系统侧实现还是终端侧实现？
在CPS-P3 R1.0和R1.5系统中，RoIP由系统实现，终端侧不实现。
CPS-ZJ R2.0和R3.5系统中，RoIP终端侧是否实现该功能？
CPS-ZJ R2.0和R3.5系统中，RoIP终端侧不实现，由系统实现。
RoIP终端侧为何不需要实现拨号规则？
因为RoIP终端侧直接获取十进制身份ID。
在系统互联侧，MPTT系统需要实现哪些拨号规则及其目的是什么？
MPTT系统需要实现NB系统的所有拨号规则，用于识别业务源方和目的方。
为什么去掉了广播全呼功能？
由于系统采用点对点，服务器性能无法达到体验要求，因此去掉了该功能。
当终端同时登记MMS业务和RoIP语音业务时，针对专网ID发起呼叫的优先策略是什么？
优先发起RoIP语音呼叫，具体取决于“通话优先级”策略。
为什么NB语音在系统间传输必须采用透传方式？
因为端到端语音加密只能在发射方和接收方加解密语音，且NB专网和RoIP专网的语音编码格式不同，为了实现RoIP和纯NB终端的互联互通，NB语音在系统间传输必须为透传。
在双模终端架构下，谁负责语音的编解码以及组包位置在哪里？
由RoIP负责语音的编解码，同时RoIP组包在宽带端进行。
RoIP业务支持哪些语音编解码格式？
RoIP业务仅支持NVOC和AMBE专网语音编解码。
使用AMBE声码器的终端能否开启RoIP功能？系统会如何提示？
无法开启RoIP功能；当尝试开启时，系统提示“不支持该业务”。
MMS业务的语音编码由什么组件进行编解码？
MMS业务的语音编码由RoIP SDK进行编解码。
当双模终端登记在POC系统时，若在接收呼叫过程中切换到NB系统，对其他终端的通话是否有影响？
不影响其他终端通话，只有此终端POC侧的组呼会被结束。
当NB支持但RoIP未支持时，开启RoIP功能会对NB和RoIP产生什么影响？
RoIP功能开启时，NB和RoIP共同禁止该功能。
在RoIP系统中，背景组、响应组和参与组在发起呼叫、接收呼叫及菜单可见性方面有何区别？
背景组：不能发起，可以接收，菜单不可见；响应组：可以发起，可以接收，菜单可见；参与组：可以发起，只有旋钮选择了该组时才能接收，菜单可见。
MPTT系统是否已实现按照终端组变化信息实时更新的策略？
未实现。
终端的组接收列表包含哪些类型的组？
接收列表包括固定列表（响应组和背景组）和动态列表（参与组以及后续DGNA和扫描组）。
当终端当前组从参与组A切换为参与组B时，SDK的接收列表如何更新？
需要把当前选择的参与组B报给SDK，并从接收列表中去掉参与组A。
当终端当前组从响应组A切换为参与组B时，接收列表会发生什么变化？
接收列表增加参与组B。
当NB登记切换到RoIP登记时，当前组上报和附着状态如何处理？
当NB登记切换到RoIP登记时，当前组上报，NB侧会上报不变；当前组附着不变，NB侧不进行去附着。
终端根据组附着实现组的收发限制时，对呼叫的发起和接收有什么具体限制？
只能发起和接收当前扫描组列表内已附着成功成员的呼叫。
当终端登记在ROIP侧时，是否仍能发起该组的呼叫？
能。和NB实现一致，当登记在ROIP侧时，仍能发起该组的呼叫。
RoIP侧终端收到新呼叫时如何处理？
RoIP侧终端收到RoIP呼叫时，会比对终端当前呼叫和新呼叫的优先级，根据优先级决定是否退出当前呼叫，加入新呼叫（公网正在通话）。
MPTT系统在授权模式和通话计时方面有哪些限制？
MPTT系统只支持PTT授权模式，不支持无PTT授权模式，授权统一归属到窄带系统进行判选。此外，MPTT系统不支持通话剩余时间下发，主叫和被叫均统一使用正计时，且不受各自计时显示参数控制。
在R2.5 ROIP侧，对于讲话方别名和环境监听功能的支持情况如何？
R2.5 ROIP侧不支持讲话方别名功能，不发送和解析讲话方别名。同时，R2.5 ROIP侧也不支持环境监听功能。环境监听是指终端配合调度台，在用户无感知的情况下采集环境音发送给调度台。
哪些类型的终端在登记成功后可以被PUC选择为动态组成员？
MPTT、ROIP和窄带终端。
PUC对动态组可以执行哪些操作？
PUC可以选择一个动态组，并进行组成员的添加或删除等操作。
PUC在处理动态组时，具体执行哪些操作，不执行哪些操作？
PUC只进行重组情况的通知和动态组成员的变更，不做动态组的增删。
界面和状态变化参考哪个文档？
《G2.0 DT 强插强拆-软件需求规格-G2.0.SRS.Force to Insert & Force to Clear Down.doc》
开启“联系人切换拆线”功能后，若终端处于通话中且旋钮对应的联系人发生改变，系统会如何执行？
系统会挂断当前呼叫，且在“迟后延迟”定时器规定的一段时间内不能进入该已挂断的呼叫。
纯NB终端发给RoIP时可能出现什么现象？原因是什么？
会出现RoIP接收消息不全或接收不到的现象，原因是跨系统长消息截断的问题。
NB和RoIP收到文本消息后，如何保证AP不会收到重复消息？
NB收到文本消息会在NB去重处理之后才给到AP；RoIP收到文本消息会给到NB去重处理之后才给到AP。两者均通过去重处理来保证AP不会收到重复的消息。
第三方SDK如何处理底层上传的关键GPS数据？
第三方SDK获取底层上传的关键GPS数据，并按照自身GPS协议进行打包。具体格式由第三方SDK规定。
RoIP开启时，是否禁止NB下的GPS数据上传功能？
不禁止。由于该功能为后台触发，因此RoIP开启时，不禁止NB下的该功能。
ROIP侧的GPS信息上报到哪里？
ROIP侧的GPS信息都是上报到GPS服务器。
调度台如何获取相应的GPS信息？
调度台从GPS服务器中获取相应的GPS信息。
双模终端在移动时，GPS上报的周期和距离策略由什么决定？
取决于调度台在窄带系统和宽带系统下发的订阅策略。
当终端双边登记在线时，选择哪一侧进行GPS上报取决于什么？
取决于GPS上报优先策略。
如何组合报警过程以满足不同场景下的数据语音报警需求？
可以将Alarm、Call、Siren等报警过程相互组合，并加上终端报警指示上的差异，搭配成不同的报警场景。
当终端触发R2.5不支持的组合功能时，系统会给出什么提示？
系统会给出提示“不支持该业务”以及提示音(Func Nagative Tone)。
什么是警报鸣笛（Alarm W/ Siren）？
警报鸣笛是紧急警报和紧急鸣笛的合集，指终端先发送正常警报后，待警报结束后，再发起本地鸣笛的流程。
当双模终端处于宽窄重叠区时，语音注册和多媒体业务注册分别如何处理？
当双模终端在宽窄重叠区时，语音注册采用已有的窄带鉴权方式发送到窄带系统，多媒体业务注册采用宽带的鉴权方式发送到宽带系统。
视频质量支持哪几种设置，且如何进行调整？
针对视频的质量支持普通、标清和高清三种设置，仅支持终端菜单设置。
同源视频组中包含哪些媒体流？
同源视频组中包含视频流和音频流。
视频上拉功能包含哪些媒体流？
视频上拉仅包含视频流，不包括音频流。
视频推送包含哪些内容，其目标可以是哪些对象？
视频推送包含视频和音频，目标可以是单个用户，也可以是群组。
多媒体短消息包含哪些内容类型，且接收该消息需要满足什么条件？
多媒体短消息包括图片、视频、音频和小文件。只有注册了多媒体业务的双模终端才能接收到该短消息。
视频推送功能对视频时长和小文件大小有什么限制？
视频支持发15S的小视频，小文件支持50M以内的文件，文件格式不限制。
NB侧一键呼叫支持的联系人类型有哪些？
NB侧一键呼叫联系人类型包括个呼、组呼、全呼、PSTN和PABX呼叫。
NB侧一键呼叫支持的呼叫或消息类型有哪些？
呼叫/消息类型包括普通呼叫、预占呼叫、紧急呼叫、文本消息、状态消息、广播组呼、预占广播组呼和紧急广播组呼。
当RoIP功能开启时，若一键呼叫配置了不支持的类型，终端会有什么反应？
NB和RoIP共同禁止该功能。终端触发该功能时，给出提示“不支持该业务”+提示音(Func Nagative Tone)（实际设计以UE为准）。
当ROIP功能和区域组群切换都开启时，切换到MPT或常规联系人后，ROIP和MMS业务会发生什么变化？
切换模式后，ROIP和MMS业务都需要进行去登记。
如果RoIP功能被禁用（Disable），终端菜单中会隐藏哪些RoIP相关的操作和设置？
终端菜单中会隐藏RoIP的操作和设置，包括但不限于：RoIP开关、RoIP呼叫记录、RoIP联系人。
当场强在什么范围内波动时，终端不启动选网？
网络切换门限±网络切换偏移值
当视频呼叫功能被设置为Disable时，终端的视频呼叫能力会受到什么影响？
终端无法发起视频呼叫和接入视频呼叫。
通过界面发起呼叫时，用户的呼叫方式由什么决定？
取决于用户的选择，与该参数无关。
如果视频上拉功能设置为Disable，会对终端产生什么影响？
终端无法对其它终端发起视频上拉功能。
Voice Item Time（单次语音呼叫时间）的作用是什么？
允许MS每次使用PTT通话的最大时间，超过该时间PTT禁发，需要再次申请授权通话。
当终端单次通话时间超时后，系统会如何处理？
系统会强制释放PTT话权，在TOT Re-key Time内，终端被禁止发射，并对发射操作进行警告。
All Call in System 的中文名称是什么？
全网全呼
预占呼叫（Preemption Call）的优先级如何定义？
预占呼叫是具有最高优先级的普通语音呼叫，其范围包括除紧急呼叫以外的所有呼叫，如个呼、组呼和广播呼叫等。
Emergency Mode（报警模式）在终端通过可编程键触发紧急报警时执行什么操作？
Emergency Mode定义了报警过程中发送的内容，即终端通过可编程键触发紧急报警功能时所执行的功能操作。
开启“忽略组属性接收紧急呼叫”功能后，终端如何接收紧急呼叫？
开启本功能后，终端选择任意联系人为当前联系人，可接收组群列表中所有参与组的紧急呼叫。
关闭“忽略组属性接收紧急呼叫”功能后，终端接收紧急呼叫的条件是什么？
关闭本功能后，终端仅接收某个参与组的紧急呼叫，并且需要将该组设置当前组。
How can users view the location and tracks of multi-mode radios if they cannot connect to the public network?
Users can view the location and tracks of radios through the offline map, which is uploaded by the radio user.
What is the purpose of setting radio aliases in batches in Smart MDM?
Setting radio aliases in batches allows the radio user to identify the callee during a narrowband call.
How can the location and tracks of radios be viewed if the Smart MDM and broadband radios cannot connect to the public network?
The location and tracks of radios can be viewed through the offline map, which is uploaded by the radio user.
Which radios support viewing the capacity and health of the smart battery via Smart MDM?
Only the radios with smart batteries support this function.
What precaution must be taken to avoid device damage when the BWC is connected to the DTW?
Do not cut off the power when the BWC is connected to the DTW through the multi-unit charger or USB hub.
What is the capacity and type of the intelligent battery listed in the standard accessories?
2900 mAh, lithium-polymer
What wireless connection technologies does the Hytera multimode radio support?
WLAN, NFC and BT
使用海能达产品前，为了避免身体伤害或财产损失，用户需要做什么？
请于使用本产品前详细阅读《安全信息手册》。
在设备文档中，符号“>”、“【】”和“””分别代表什么含义？
符号“>”用于对多级菜单进行逐级指引；符号“【】”表示硬件界面控件名称；符号“””表示软件界面控件名称。
在蓝牙连接状态下切换语音播放设备（如从蓝牙切换到对讲机）时，是否需要断开或重新连接蓝牙？
无须断开或重新连接蓝牙。
顶屏图标中，电池电量显示越满代表什么状态？
电池电量越足。
附件图标中，符号“B·”表示蓝牙处于什么状态？
已成功连接蓝牙配件。
如何进入小组件界面并展开当前组件的更多内容？
在待机界面向右滑动或双击【智能】键可访问小组件界面。点击 > 或 ∨ 图标，可以展开或折叠当前组件的更多内容。
如何管理文件夹中的通话组（添加或删除）？
添加组：选择文件夹，点击 + ，选择“添加组”并勾选通话组。删除组：选择文件夹，长按并勾选通话组，点击“删除”。
收藏夹功能有什么特点和使用限制？
收藏夹是一种特殊的文件夹，可以实现跨工作模式的通话组切换。该功能需要经销商开启后才能使用。
外放式语音通路在高音增强模式下的具体增益数值是多少？
外放式语音通路在高音增强模式下的增益数值分别为 0 dB、0 dB、8 dB 和 3 dB。
触发对讲机主动上传定位数据到调度台的条件有哪些？
触发条件包括时间、距离、开机或关机、开启或关闭发射限制模式、切换工作模式等。
开启隐蔽模式有哪些表现和前提条件？
开启隐蔽模式后，对讲机会禁用提示音、振动及指示灯，主屏显示为最低亮度。此时需连接音频配件才能输出语音。
在浏览器中如何查找网页上的特定信息，搜索结果如何显示？
点击“在网页上查找”，在文本输入框中输入关键信息，对讲机将查找当前网页并将搜索结果以黄色高亮背景显示。
路航功能适用于哪种类型的对讲机，使用前需要确认开启哪些功能？
路航功能用于有 GPS 模块的对讲机。使用该功能前，请确认是否已开启 GPS 和校准指南针。
如何设置护眼模式，该模式下屏幕显示有什么特点？
点击“护眼模式”，点击“立即开启”。护眼模式下屏幕显示偏暖，可以减少蓝光伤害。
如何在对讲机中设置情景模式并调节音量及提示音？
点击“设置”，选择“声音”，根据不同的使用场景设置对讲机的情景模式为标准模式和隐蔽模式，进而调节音量和设置提示音。
在对讲机的日期和时间设置中，如何手动设置当前日期、时间以及时区？
关闭“自动设置时间”开关，点击“日期”和“时间”，手动设置当前日期和时间；关闭“自动确定时区”开关，点击“选择时区”，手动选择时区。
开启手套模式的作用是什么，如何进入该设置？
开启手套模式可使对讲机增加屏幕触摸灵敏度，方便佩戴手套使用触摸屏。进入路径为：点击“设置”，在“特色功能”中选择“手套模式”。
当接收方与发送方对讲机的状态信息内容不一致时，应如何解决？
重新定义状态信息 ID，确保接收方与发送方对讲机的状态信息 ID 保持一致。
对讲机浸入液体后，有哪些绝对禁止的操作？如果内部严重浸水该怎么办？
禁止的操作包括：开机、连接外部配件或充电；使用外部热源（如微波炉、吹风机热风）干燥；将棉签或纸巾塞入接口。若内部严重浸水，请勿开机，应尽快联系经销商或维修中心进行检修。
ACN-02 配件的使用搭配要求是什么？
ACN-02（PTT&MIC 控制线）需搭配只接收耳机使用。
EH-02 和 ES-01 这两款耳机在使用时有什么共同限制？
EH-02（耳挂式只接收耳机）和 ES-01（耳塞式只接收耳机）均需搭配 PTT&MIC 控制线使用。
双引号（“”）在文档格式规范中表示什么？
该符号表示软件界面控件名称。
符号“$->$”在操作指引中起什么作用？
用于对多级菜单进行逐级指引。
SmartMDM Pro 的插件支持哪些类型的终端或设备写频？
包括多模终端、窄带 DMR 终端、窄带 TETRA 终端、窄带 PDT 终端和执法记录仪。
在步骤2中，应使用哪个用户通过Xftp工具上传文件？
应使用 root 用户。
该站点使用的协议和端口号分别是什么？
协议为 SFTP，端口号为 22。
什么情况下表明设备与 DTW 的连接不稳定？
设备无法连接 DTW 或执行任务时。
Digital USB Driver Software 对应的是哪种终端的驱动？
窄带 DMR 终端。
若QMAX/DC为80%，SOH为68%，循环次数为500次，UI SOH显示值是多少？依据是什么？
80%。依据是QMAX/DC和SOH取最大值。
在区间范围内显示QMAX/DC和SOH时，需要执行什么防抖操作？
Qmax和SOH均需读取三次做防抖。
充电截止的条件是什么，以确保充满且解决开机充电正常截止？
充电到100%且电流≤200mA，再充30min截止。
当充电器处于空载状态时，指示灯的状态及对应的充电器工作状态是什么？
指示灯状态为红灯慢闪(0.2SON/3S OFF)，对应充电器状态为激活、校准、修复过程。
在智能电池管理中，充电截止策略针对座充和TypeC接口分别如何设定复充起充电量？
座充的复充起充电量设定为90%，而TypeC接口维持原来的95%，这是因为TypeC可以直接供电。
当电池处于智能浮充充电状态且充满超过72小时，系统会采取什么措施？
系统会将复充时的充电电量降低至80%。此信息需要更新到说明书中。
对于健康度被上报为“立即更换”的电池，其充电电量和显示映射策略是什么？
仅对“立即更换”状态的电池执行降电量充电，电量降为85%。主机和分析仪会通过1.18的系数将电量映射显示为100%。上报给MDM的电量为原始数据，MDM也需要做相应的映射。
在UI显示上，关于电池健康状态和老化提示文案做了哪些修改？
健康状态文案由“健康”改为“良好”；电池老化提示由“电池老化，请立即更换”改为“电池老化，请尽快更换”，英文翻译定为“Replace Soon”。
未经事先书面授权，用户不得对计算机程序进行哪些操作？
未经我司事先书面授权，任何企业、组织或个人不得对计算机程序进行任何形式的复制、更改、散发、反编译和反向工程。
如何设置自动锁键盘功能及其时长？
在待机界面下，按【确认/菜单】键选择“设置 > 对讲机偏好设置 > 锁键盘”菜单，开启或关闭自动锁键盘。开启后，选择“自动上锁时长”进行设置，在设定时间内若无任何操作，终端将自动锁定键盘。
当设备显示PI、PE、DD、EE、SS、AA图标时，分别表示开启了什么功能或处于什么状态？
这些图标分别表示：PI为扫描停留于优先信道1；PE为扫描停留于优先信道2；DD为已开启监听功能；EE为已开启扰频功能；SS为已开启静噪功能；AA为已开启紧急呼叫。
对讲机指示灯显示橙色常亮代表什么状态，此时如何回呼？
橙色常亮表示专网数字模式下的呼叫保持状态（即呼叫建立无人讲话时）。此时可以按住【PTT】键进行回呼。
如果本产品浸入液体，在干燥过程中有哪些禁止操作？
请勿开机、连接外部配件或充电；请勿使用微波炉、吹风机热风等外部热源来干燥；请勿将棉签或纸巾等塞入接口。
在使用中性洗涤剂清洁产品表面时，应如何操作以防止液体进入内部？
应将适量的中性洗涤剂喷洒在干净的无线软布上，并在清洁前拧干多余的溶液，严禁将洗涤剂直接喷洒在产品上。
对本产品进行消毒时，推荐使用什么浓度的酒精以及具体的操作步骤是什么？
推荐使用浓度不少于 70% 的外用酒精。操作时，用干净的无线软布蘸取酒精并拧干多余溶液，然后轻轻擦拭设备表面、屏幕、控制旋钮、按键及接口处。消毒附件接口前需取下接口盖，完成后盖上。
Which EU directives and regulations does the Declaration of Conformity for Hytera's Advanced Multimode Radio comply with?
The product complies with the essential requirements of Directive RE 2014/53/EU and the requirements of Directive 2011/65/EU with (EU) 2015/863.
PDC580的通话录音时长和支持的回放功能是什么？
通话录音长达500小时，支持一键回放。
该设备的屏幕规格是什么？
1.8英寸半透LCD屏，160x128像素
首次登录 PPS Web 客户端后需要执行什么操作？
首次登录后请修改密码。
PDC680多模智能对讲机在职业或受控环境中使用时，发送时间有何限制？
发送时间不得超过额定因数的 50%（最高 50%的时间发射）。
使用PDC680多模智能对讲机进行发射（讲话）时，对讲机与身体应保持的最小距离是多少？
发射时对讲机与身体的距离至少保持在 2.5 厘米以上。
如果需要对PDC680多模智能对讲机手册中涉及的计算机程序进行反编译或反向工程，需要满足什么条件？
必须获得我司的事先书面授权。
当设备指示灯呈现蓝色亮3秒或红色闪烁时，分别表示什么状态？
蓝色亮3秒表示已成功连接蓝牙设备；红色闪烁表示有未读信息或未接来电。
设备指示灯显示红色爆闪代表什么状态，应如何处理？
红色爆闪表示电池电量不足，请尽快充电或更换电池。
充电座 LED 指示灯显示红色常亮、绿色常亮和红色快闪分别代表什么状态？
红色常亮表示正在充电；绿色常亮表示整机充电已充满 90% 或以上，或电池单独充电已充满 95% 或以上；红色快闪表示充电过程中出现异常。
在控制与通知中心中，如何查看、清除或屏蔽单条通知？
点击单条通知可展开查看详情，向上滑动可查看较早通知。向左滑并点击可屏蔽消息，向右滑并点击“清除”可清除消息。也可在底部点击清除全部通知。
超时禁发功能的触发条件、默认时长及恢复通话的方法是什么？
当个呼或组呼时按住【PTT】键的持续时间超过预设单次发射时间（默认为 60 秒），对讲机将自动终止发射并发出警告音。松开【PTT】键可以停止警告音。如需再次通话，请在预设时间后再次按住【PTT】键发射。此功能默认开启。
开启飞行模式后如何使用蓝牙或WLAN业务？
开启飞行模式后，默认无法使用语音和数据业务。如果航空公司允许，可以手动开启蓝牙、WLAN或窄带网络以使用这些业务。
如何通过开发者选项选择 USB 的使用方式？
打开通知中心，点击“正在通过 USB 与此设备连接”，在开发者选项界面点击“选择 USB 配置”，选择合适的 USB 使用方式。
MIDI的全称是什么，它在编曲界的地位如何？
MIDI的全称是Musical Instrument Digital Interface（乐器数字接口），它是编曲界最广泛的音乐标准格式，也是电子乐器制造商们建立的通信标准。
E2EE为对讲机提供哪些安全保护？
E2EE为语音或数据提供可靠的安全保护，可以有效防止被偷听或被窃取。
如果对讲机被调度台或系统遥毙，用户应如何处理才能重新使用？
对讲机被遥毙后会失去除开关机外的所有功能。若想重新使用，需将对讲机返回我司处理。
如何设置对讲机的定位服务模式为“高精确度”或“仅限设备”？
首先选择“位置信息 > 定位服务”，开启定位服务开关，然后设置“模式”为“高精确度”或“仅限设备”。
对讲机的倒放功能在什么条件下会自动进入紧急报警模式？
当对讲机倾斜的角度大于预设角度，或保持相对静止（或匀速运动）超过预设时间后，支持紧急报警的对讲机将自动进入紧急报警模式。
如何退出对讲机的倒放预警提示？
移动或扶正对讲机可退出预警提示。
在对讲机中切换声码器类型的具体操作步骤是什么？
点击“设置”，选择“声音 > 声码器”，从选项中选择声码器类型，设备自动重启后切换生效。
在图库中，如何分别按时间和文件夹查看照片或视频？
打开图库后，点击“照片”页签可以按时间查看，点击“相册”页签可以按文件夹查看。
路航功能适用于哪种设备，且使用前需要确认开启哪些设置？
路航功能用于有 GPS 模块的对讲机。使用该功能前，请确认是否已开启 GPS 和校准指南针。
在日历设置中，如何配置一周的起始日以及外出时的时区显示？
点击“一周起始日”，可选择“语言区域的默认设置”、“星期六”、“星期日”或“星期一”作为一周起始日。开启“采用家里的时区”并选择时区，外出时将以原居住地时区显示日历和活动时间。
如何设置网页是否显示图片？
选择“设置 > 宽带管理”，勾选或去勾选“加载图片”。
清洁对讲机机身和按键时，可以使用哪些清洁剂？严禁使用哪些化学药剂？
可用中性洗涤剂和无纺布对按键和机壳进行清洁。严禁使用去污剂、酒精、喷雾剂或石油制剂等化学药剂，以避免产品表面和外壳受损。
KMS 软件包含哪两类用户，它们的界面有何区别？
本软件包括管理员（Admin）和普通用户两类用户，不同类型的用户所能操作的软件主界面不同。
KMS 软件区域 1 中，管理员用户和普通用户的操作是否相同？
此处管理员用户和普通用户的操作相同。
配置界面支持执行哪些具体操作？
配置界面支持创建和删除密钥，创建、删除、导入和导出密钥包，分发密钥到终端，终止任务和重做任务，管理帐号以及查看日志等操作。
TETRA多模终端的终端TEI是什么格式的号码？
终端TEI是终端设备识别码，为15位十六进制号码。
KMS 系统在用户多久未操作后会自动注销？
超过 10 分钟未操作 KMS，系统将自动注销。
在海能达产品手册中，符号“>”、“【】”和“ ”分别代表什么含义？
符号“>”用于对多级菜单进行逐级指引；“【】”表示硬件界面控件名称；“ ”表示软件界面控件名称。
Who holds the authority to clear a group call, and how can this ownership be transferred?
The call owner is the only party with authority to clear the call. Ownership can be transferred by use of the Transfer of Control (ToC) supplementary service.
How does half duplex operation function in group calls?
Group calls can only operate in voice half duplex i.e. one party speaks whilst the other parties listen.
How is inter-working defined and what interface specification supports it?
Inter-working is the ability of equipment from the same system to communicate together from different systems. It relies on the specification of the Inter-System Interface (ISI) I3.
What is a pressel and how can it be activated?

A pressel is the press-to-talk switch used in semi-duplex and simplex radio applications when the user wishes to speak. It can be activated manually by the user pressing a contact or electronically, for instance by a Voice Activity Detector (VAD).
What are the characteristics of the User-plane (U-plane)?
The User-plane (U-plane) is a system traffic scheme that provides constant delay characteristics without addressing.
Who are the authors of the paper titled "Development of a mobile radio system using directional antennas"?
The authors are S. H. Kim, K. N. Lee, and Y.-H. Park.
In which city and month was the paper "Mobile radio communication systems based on cellular technology" presented?
It was presented in Los Angeles in July 1992.
How should a Mobile Station (MS) determine if it needs to register before making a call request?

The MS should continuously monitor system broadcasts to ascertain whether it needs to register before making a call request, as the acceptance of call requests from unregistered MSs is a network operator option that may change during the course of the day.
How do different trunking methods determine optimal solutions, and what is required to gain insight into their performance?

Optimal solutions are defined in terms of efficient use of resources, time to access the system, reliability of call retention, or other suitable parameters, depending on traffic distribution and profile. Gaining significant insight requires extensive simulations.
What is the primary advantage of message trunking regarding user experience and infrastructure?

Users experience minimum delay at each new call transaction because there is no queuing for channel resources, ensuring uninterrupted conversation. Additionally, this strategy minimizes processing and signalling overheads in the infrastructure.
How does a mix of two-way conversations and query-response transactions affect system access for query-response users?

Parties to query-response transactions may be inhibited from accessing the system by prolonged conversations because their slower response times make them vulnerable to being blocked by the continuous flow of two-way conversations.
What are the two cardinal aspects of protocol transfer that communication networks must support?

Communication networks must ensure that data arrives at the destination correctly and in a timely manner, and that data delivered to the user at the destination is recognizable and in the proper form for its correct use.
How does the layered architecture concept ensure that changes to one layer do not affect others?
Changes to a layer are transparent to the layers above and below provided the interface signals passed between layers remain unchanged.
How do the physical link requirements differ between C-plane and U-plane information?
C-plane information needs only a discrete (or non-continuous) physical link to pass information, whereas U-plane information requires a regular physical link to be available.
Which radio oriented aspects are handled by the physical layer?
The physical layer deals with modulation and demodulation, receiver and transmitter switching, frequency correction, symbol synchronization, and power control (MS only).
How is the physical resource available to the radio sub-system partitioned?
The physical resource, which is an allocation of part of the radio spectrum, is partitioned both in frequency and time.
Which logical channels handle control information for MSs involved in a circuit mode call?
The Associated Control Channel (ACCH) handles this information. It comprises the Fast Associated Control Channel (FACCH) and the Slow Associated Control Channel (SACCH).
What channel configuration is required when both parties in a duplex call are on the same site?
A separate channel, consisting of an uplink and downlink pair, is needed for each party.
What is the primary disadvantage of distributing traffic from frame 18 among other frames with compression?
The primary disadvantage is the introduction of an inherent latency time to the transfer of speech and circuit mode data, which is of the order of 200 ms.
Which three varieties of associated control channels are available to MSs assigned to a particular physical channel during a circuit mode call?
The three varieties of associated control channels are the FACCH, the SACCH, and the STEaling CHannel (STCH).
How does the MAC determine that it is involved in a circuit mode call?
The MAC knows it is involved in a circuit mode call because it has been assigned to a particular physical channel.
How does the STCH differ from FACCH regarding its coexistence with TCH?
Unlike FACCH, the STCH can exist at the same time as the TCH.
How do optional procedures supported by the standard enhance the efficiency of setting up wide area group calls?
They allow the group call to be set-up on the site but cleared down soon after if power measurements indicate that a member of the group is not present on the site.
What mechanism is used to notify group members who switch on or enter the BS coverage area that a group call is in progress?
A late entry message is regularly transmitted on the site for the duration of the group call.
Who determines the precise signalling channels used for setting up an acknowledged group call, and are these channels defined in the standard?
The precise signalling channels are not defined in the standard; they are chosen by the system designer from those described previously.
How does the Base Station (BS) respond to a random access attempt from the calling MS M1?
The BS acknowledges the request in its next slot 1 (d-call-proceeding) and at the same time pages the called MS M2 (d-set-up).
Under direct signalling, when is the response from the called radio returned?
The response is returned in the subsequent slot 1 (u-connect).
How does the procedure for indicating presence differ when the calling and called parties are on the same site versus separate sites?

If on the same site, the called party may indicate presence with the MAC-access message as instructed by the BS. If on separate sites, both MSs can indicate presence in the second half slot after linearization.
Why is the group call message sequence shorter than the individual call sequence?
It is shorter because the BS immediately assigns a traffic channel in response to the u-set-up.
From the network operator perspective, which aspects of call establishment and re-establishment are controlled by system broadcasts?
All aspects except the decision when to do it are controlled by system broadcasts.
In carrier sharing mode, how many cells can share one carrier frequency pair and where is this technique typically used?
In carrier sharing mode, one carrier frequency pair may be shared by up to four cells. This technique provides an efficient use of spectrum and may find use in low traffic areas.
Why does the MAC report C-plane stealing to the U-plane application?
To enable the application to revise the intended use of subsequent half slots or to re-transmit any U-plane signalling that has been overwritten by the MAC.
What is the nominal power in dBm for a Power class 2 device?
40 dBm
What is the maximum number of simultaneous duplex voice circuits an MS can support for concurrent calls?
An MS can support up to four simultaneous duplex voice circuits to different remote users, each with a different vocoder and a different encryption algorithm.
How is the use of optional user facilities handled in a DTE/DTE environment regarding transmission direction?
In a DTE/DTE environment, the use of these facilities is agreed separately for each direction of transmission.
What is the main disadvantage of using a single site for wide area coverage in a simple radio system?

The disadvantage is that more channels may need to be provided on the site to meet capacity requirements, and the re-use distance of these radio channels by other systems will be limited by interference.
In what scenarios is quasi-synchronous transmission typically used?

Quasi-synchronous transmission is used in areas that cannot be covered by one site and where a limited number of radio channels are available, such as rural areas with low traffic density. It is also often used in urban areas to provide more reliable coverage.
What factors determine the Doppler shift associated with each partial wave in a mobile radio environment?
The Doppler shift depends on the Mobile Station's velocity and the angle of incidence.
How do the simulation results for HT50, BU50, and RA200 differ in status from those for static, TU50, HT200, and EQ200 conditions?

The results for HT50, BU50, and RA200 are only informative but not normative, whereas the TETRA standard specifies minimum required sensitivity performance for static, TU50, HT200 and EQ200 conditions.
How is the maximum usable sensitivity of an analogue FM receiver defined according to ETS 300 086?

According to ETS 300 086, the maximum usable sensitivity of an analogue FM receiver is defined as the input signal level providing a psophometrically weighted (p.w.) SINAD (S+N+D)/(N+D) of 20 dB in static conditions using the normal test modulation.
How does the path loss exponent, $n$, vary between rural and suburban areas?
The path loss exponent, $n$, is close to 4 for rural areas and slightly less for suburban areas.
In what unit are the wideband noise levels expressed, and what is the minimum absolute limit that applies regardless of the relative level?
All levels are expressed in dBC relative to the actual transmitted power level, and in any case no limit tighter than -70dBm apply.
How is the transmission of speech samples handled during the 18th frame period to achieve minimum overall delay?
Speech samples taken over the 18th frame period are buffered and gradually sent in the following 17 frame periods, as no speech data is sent in frame 18.
Which GSM specification covers Radio Network Planning Aspects?
GSM 03.30 covers Radio Network Planning Aspects.
终端在被远程监听或环境侦听期间，用户操作声码器切换会有什么结果？
终端会响应声码器切换，同时远程监听和环境侦听结束。
在终端监听状态下，声码器切换的响应条件是什么？
如果终端监听时喇叭打开且没有在接收发射状态，则响应声码器切换；若监听时收到语音，则不能切换声码器。
声码器切换的性能要求及主机与AP屏幕的交互表现是怎样的？
交互表现：主机菜单执行切换模式时，AP屏幕会显示切换中的提示信息，宽带通知窄带同步声码器类型。 性能要求：由于需要初始化声码器，允许切换时间最长为2秒，切换完成后返回。
如何避免降低终端天线的工作性能和使用寿命？
请勿手持天线顶端甩动终端。
充电座 LED 指示灯显示绿色常亮代表什么状态？
电池单独充电已充满 95% 或以上
主屏图标显示 G/E/3G/4G 时代表什么状态？
表示已开启 E/G/3G/4G 数据网络。
指示灯绿色慢闪代表设备处于什么状态？
代表集群模式下注册后待机。
在通话过程中，指示灯橙色常亮期间用户可以执行什么操作？
用户可以按住【PTT】键讲话。
当Smart MDM系统遭遇自然灾害或人为误操作等灾难时，如何保障业务连续性？
系统通过异地备份方案，自动将服务从主服务器切换到备用服务器。备用服务器可以快速接管业务，恢复生产运营，从而减少服务中断时间。
How can a user unlock a radio screen that has been locked remotely via MDM?
The user cannot unlock the screen manually; it can only be unlocked via MDM.
What happens to radio operation after the radio is locked remotely via MDM?
The radio cannot be operated, and it can be unlocked via MDM only.
What happens to locally stored digital evidences after they are archived in IDS?
IDS automatically deletes the digital evidences stored in the local path after they are archived.
Which user roles are included in IDS and what are their respective permissions?

IDS users include admin, normal user, and visitors. The admin user can set system, RVM, and basic parameters to view and manage digital evidences. Normal users can set basic parameters, view, and manage digital evidences. Visitors can view task execution status only.
How are broadband and narrowband templates managed to prevent unexpected default settings?

Broadband and narrowband parameters are configured separately. The super administrator assigns administrators permissions for either narrowband or broadband services, and administrators can only manage and use templates of the authorized service.
What action is required if IDS receives a programming task while performing data acquisition?
You need to reconnect the RVM to finish the programming task.
What is the primary function of the United User Center (UUC) in Smart MDM?
The United User Center (UUC) is used to manage users and organizations in a unified way, eliminating the need to create users and organizations directly on the Smart MDM.
How can an administrator utilize Smart MDM Web if a multi-mode advanced radio is lost?
If the radio is lost, the administrator can check its location on the map through the Smart MDM Web.
Besides locating a lost device, what other purpose does tracking a multi-mode advanced radio serve?
The administrator can track the radio to confirm whether the patrol route is correct.
MDM Pro 支持对多模终端进行哪些具体的业务操作？
MDM Pro 支持对多模终端进行批量化写频、升级、密钥管理、权限控制、应用推送和公文推送等业务。
MDM Pro 通过什么方式实现对终端和事务的管控？
使用网页管控终端和事务。
在使用 MDM Pro 管控终端前，需要获取哪些授权或硬件以拥有永久使用权？
需自行下单加密狗以及基础版或旗舰版的 License。
MDM_Pro_V6.0.XX.XXX.zip 的功能定位是什么？
MDM 基础程序包
如何设置系统分区并选择硬盘？
单击 “Installation Destination”。
MDM Pro 界面中提供了哪些与系统许可证相关的操作选项？
导出系统许可证和导入系统许可证。
MDM Pro 管理站与 MDM SE 工作站在屏幕分辨率要求上有何不同？
MDM Pro 管理站要求屏幕分辨率为 1280x768 或以上，而 MDM SE 工作站要求 1920x1080 或以上。
What is the specific cron schedule expression used for the ntpdate task in the provided configuration?
Quick Log功能点的具体实现流程和界面展现形式以什么为准？
以开发部门的设计为准。
Quick Log的主要设计目标是什么？
实现快速抓取日志功能，让终端用户无需进行复杂操作即可获得日志并分析异常。
如何进入Quick Log应用？其界面显示语言遵循什么规则？
通过拨号号码“*#*#0311#*#*”进入该APP。界面支持中英文，具体跟随宽带系统“设置”里的语言进行显示：若“设置”中为中文，则以中文显示；否则，均以英文显示。
对文件夹进行分享操作时有什么特殊要求？生成的压缩文件默认保存在哪里，命名规则是什么？
对文件夹进行分享时，提示用户需压缩后分享。生成的压缩文件自动保存至原文件目录下，命名规则为：原文件名.zip。
在Quick Log运行过程中，如果有大屏全屏的新业务（如来电）产生，系统会如何响应？
系统会切换出Quick Log，使其退至后台运行；待新业务（如来电）结束后，再切换回Quick Log界面。
如果用户关闭了新产生的大屏非全屏业务，Quick Log 会如何运行？
继续运行 Quick Log。
What actions can be performed under the User Settings menu?
Create or delete users except Admin and the current user.
What are the steps to import a radio file in KMC?
Step 1: Click Import Radio File, choose a radio file and click Open. Step 2: Choose the radio type, enter user name and password in the log in page.
What are the steps to manually configure a new TEI-K entry?
First, click K to access the configuration page. Then, click New TEI-K, enter the key file name, and click OK in the New File window. Finally, click New and enter the TEI and K values.
Which option should be selected if you have a radio TEI file versus if you do not have TEI-K or TEI files?
If you have the radio TEI file, choose New TEI-K. If you don't have TEI-K and TEI files, choose New K-Only.
What are the steps to configure SCK keys?

1. Click SCK to access the configuration page. 2. Click New, enter the file name, and click OK in the popped window New File. 3. Enter the SCK version number in the Version column and configure the SCK key. 4. Click Save&Exit.
How do you generate multiple K keys at once?
Click Batch and enter the quantity of key in the popped window.
What are the steps to generate a key pack by associating a key application form (Method 1)?

1. Click New to access the configuration page. 2. Enter the name of the key file pack. 3. Choose a key application form and check Application Form. 4. (Optional) Choose the K File Type (TEI-K or KOOnly for authentication keys; ignore for others). 5. Choose the key file from the drop down list. 6. Click Create Key Pack, choose the save path, and click OK.
In Method 2, what happens if the Application Form is not checked when creating a key file pack?
If the Application Form is not checked, you need to manually configure the key options.
How can you add a conventional AIE key file?

To add a conventional AIE key file: 1. Click AIE to access the configuration page. 2. Click New, enter the file name, and click OK in the popped window New File. 3. Configure the key length and value.
How can the hexadecimal E2EE key value be modified or updated?
You can manually modify the key value, or click Update to regenerate the value.
What is the procedure for Method 3 to generate a key pack?
Method 3 is to import key file pack and then use the key application form to generate key pack.
Under what condition is the radio TEI/ESN written to the card?
The radio TEI/ESN is written to the card only when the configuration option is checked.
Which users are restricted from being deleted by an administrator?
An administrator can delete all users except the Admin account and the current login user.
What action should be taken after entering the file name and choosing the save path in the popped window?
Click Save.
What are the steps to perform OTAP on a multi-mode radio?

1. From the navigation panel, go to Multi-mode > Device. 2. Select the online radio, and then click OTAP. 3. (Optional) Click Read to read current settings of the device. This step is available when you select only one device. 4. Configure the parameters, and then click Confirm.
What does the 'Lost' status indicate regarding battery information in MDM Pro?
The 'Lost' status indicates that the battery information has not been updated in MDM Pro for a duration that exceeds the preset days.
How can a user switch map providers and display modes on the Map interface?
To switch the display mode, select Standard or RSSI Heatmap in the upper-left corner. To switch map providers, select Amap, Google Maps, or Offline Map in the upper-right corner.
What steps are required to view the location history of a specific device on the Map?
Click the device on the map, and then click Location History.
How do you navigate to a target position after receiving a short message with a location?

Start the radio and tap Messages, then tap the location in the message. Tap Route Trace to enable it to search for the location, tap to start the third-party map, and follow the navigation to the target position.
海外标准支持的16个动态组联系人中，地址模式和别名模式各占多少个？
海外标准支持16个动态组联系人，其中地址模式15个，别名模式1个。
终端在保存DGNA标准时有什么限制？
终端中只能保存一种标准下的DGNA，不能混合保存。
终端在有线或无线写频后开机时，对动态组有何处理？动态组与静态组重号时如何显示？
终端有线或无线写频后开机时，会删除所有动态组。当动态组跟静态组重号时，按照终端检索策略先检索静态组，因此即使当前待机组为动态组，呼叫时显示的也是静态组的别名。
终端保存动态组的容量限制及满员后的处理机制是怎样的？
终端最多保存16*2个动态组，即2个动态组群，每个动态组群中最多保存16个动态组。终端收到多个动态组时依次添加，动态组群1满则添加到动态组群2中，全部满员后拒绝“动态组增加”信令。
在地址模式下发的动态组ID中，如果存在与别名模式动态组ID相同的情况，系统会如何处理？
不在地址模式中保存此动态组。
G1.0终端是否会出现地址模式中的动态组ID与别名模式的动态组ID相同的情况？
是，G1.0终端会出现地址模式中的动态组ID与别名模式的动态组ID相同的情况。
当终端收到通过别名模式下发的动态组，且其ID与地址模式中某个动态组ID相同时，应如何处理？
直接修改地址模式里该动态组的别名，无需将此别名动态组保存，别名空间中已有动态组保持不变。
若收到的别名动态组ID与别名空间中的动态组ID相同，系统执行什么操作？
修改别名空间里该动态组的别名。
当收到的动态组ID与地址空间的任何动态组ID都不相同时，该如何处理该动态组？
将此动态组保存到别名空间里；如果别名空间已有动态组，则直接替换已有动态组。
如果动态组ID与已有普通组ID一致，终端应如何处理？
保存该组ID到动态组群，并向系统返回成功ACK。
当动态组群空间已满时，终端可以进行哪些操作？
不可以继续添加，但可以删除和更改。
如何判断是否需要将当前旋钮位置对应的组临时替换为第一个动态组？
根据C_UDTDD信令中的OK字段进行判断。
动态重组过程是否会影响旋钮位置对应的联系人？
不影响。
当系统通过地址模式下发多个DGNA地址时，终端如何存储这些地址？
终端将这些DGNA地址保存在预留的地址空间里。
当终端将地址空间中已保存的DGNA与系统通过地址模式下发的新DGNA进行匹配时，如果匹配到相同的DGNA ID，会如何处理？
地址空间里的该DGNA保留，不做删除，且ID对应的别名也会保存下来。
在DGNA地址匹配过程中，如果未匹配到相同的DGNA ID，终端会对地址空间中的对应项执行什么操作？
删除地址空间中对应的DGNA，包括ID对应的别名。
如果下发的DGNA地址不足15个，不足的地址如何处理？
不足的地址预留为空。
当系统通过别名模式下发1个DGNA别名且终端匹配上地址空间的DGNA地址时，终端如何操作？
将地址空间里相同的DGNA地址别名同步修改。
当系统通过别名模式下发1个DGNA别名但终端未匹配上地址空间的DGNA地址时，终端如何操作？
地址空间不做更新，将该DGNA别名保存到别名空间；如果别名空间已有其他别名，则先删除，再保存。
当系统通过别名模式下发1个DGNA别名时，终端将该别名保存在哪里？若该位置已有其他别名如何处理？
终端将该DGNA地址保存在预留的别名空间里；如果别名空间已有其他别名，则先删除，再保存。
当系统通过地址模式下发多个DGNA地址时，终端首先执行什么操作？
终端先将这些DGNA地址去匹配别名空间里的DGNA地址。
如果下发的DGNA地址在别名空间中匹配成功，终端会如何处理？
将通过地址模式下发的该DGNA地址的别名同步修改。
终端将DGNA地址保存到地址空间时，如果该地址已存在，应如何操作？
先删除，再保存。
当动态组ID和已有普通组ID一致时，系统会执行哪些操作？
系统会将该组ID保存到动态组群，并向系统返回成功ACK。
当目的ID为动态组号或0时，终端应执行什么操作并如何响应TS？
如果目的ID是某个动态组号，则删除该动态组；如果目的ID为0，则删除所有动态组。操作完成后向TS返回成功ACK。
C_AHOY指令在删除动态组群联系人时有什么限制？
C_AHOY只能删除动态组群中的组呼联系人。
若当前组是用户手动修改过的动态组，收到删除指令后终端如何切换当前组？
如果删除后终端里不再存在任何动态组，终端会切到首次开机时的默认当前组（即终端第一个组群的第一个组呼联系人）；如果删除后终端里还存在其他动态组，终端会切到下一个动态组。
导入系统许可证时，选择特定设备类型会对左侧导航栏产生什么影响？
左侧导航栏仅显示和该设备类型有关的功能入口。
登录 MDM Pro 前必须完成哪些操作？
必须阅读并同意《软件许可协议》与《用户隐私协议》。
无线电通信部门的主要职责是什么？
确保所有无线电通信服务能够以合理、公平、有效和经济的方式使用无线电频谱，包括使用卫星，进行不受频率范围限制的研究，并在此基础上采纳建议书。
无线电通信部门通过哪些机制履行其监管和政策功能？
通过由研究组支持的世界和区域性无线电大会和无线电通信全会来履行。
谁为无线电通信部门履行监管和政策功能提供支持？
研究组。
陆地移动通信手册第 4 卷提供了直到何时为止在 ITS 中所使用的无线通信的描述？
旅行者或行人使用ITS的主要用途有哪些？
旅行者或行人使用ITS来获取交通信息、规划行程、使用运输服务或请求紧急救援。
在环境类别中，与生态交通信号灯相关的具体应用有哪些？
在环境类别中，与生态交通信号灯相关的应用包括生态交通信号灯配时和生态交通信号灯优先级。
无线电通信业务主要描述了什么内容？
无线电通信业务描述了其业务功能和技术特性。
ETC系统可以使用哪些通信技术？
ETC可使用DSRC、中短程通信技术或基于网络的蜂窝技术。
在路口存在建筑物遮挡视线的情况下，车辆如何识别其他正在靠近的车辆并防止碰撞？
通过车到车 (V2V) 通信，车辆之间周期性地传输其位置和状态，从而识别到其他车辆正在靠近并采取措施防止碰撞。
交通效率在ITS业务和智能交通系统中扮演什么角色？
交通效率是ITS业务的主要场景，也是使用基于LTE的V2X系统的智能交通的重要组成部分。
V2X为自动驾驶提供了哪些超越传统感知的能力？
V2X为自动驾驶提供了“超感官”感知能力，能够沟通驾驶意图并协商合作操作。
在车辆编队应用中，跟随车辆如何保持稳定的车间距离？
基于实时信息交互，以一定速度保持稳定的车间距离。
车辆编队应用支持哪些具体功能？
支持车道保持与跟踪、协同自适应巡航、协同紧急制动、协同变道提醒、进出队列等。
V2V通信与车辆传感器共同支持哪些功能？
紧急制动预警、交叉路口防碰撞预警和协同式自适应巡航控制 (CACC)。
带有车辆传感器或道路传感器的V2X支持哪些应用？
自动代客泊车和自动驾驶。
带有传感器的V2X主要支持哪两类高级驾驶功能？
带有传感器的V2X主要支持自动代人泊车和自动驾驶这两类功能。
协同式智能交通体系结构参考 (ARC-IT) 包含哪四个架构观点？
ARC-IT 包括企业观点、功能视图、物理视图和通信视图这四个不同的架构角度。
ARC-IT企业视图中的基本构件是什么，它们主要用于什么场景？
ARC-IT的企业视图构件是企业对象。这些对象可以交互交换信息，管理和操作超出一个组织范围的系统。
功能视图的主要作用是什么？
功能视图定义进程以控制和管理系统行为（例如监测），以及其他属于描述系统功能行为的其他有源控制元素。
在描述系统功能行为的有源控制元素中，还描述了哪些内容？
在这些元素中还描述了数据处理功能、数据存储和信息的逻辑流。
在物理视图中，体系结构是如何被描述的？
体系结构被描述为一组集成的物理对象（子系统和终止器），它们互动和交换信息以支持体系结构服务包。
物理视图中的功能对象与功能视图之间存在怎样的关联？
每个功能对象都连接至功能视图，功能视图更准确地描述所执行的功能和对象交换的数据的细节。
信息流三元组如何映射到标准或规范以构建可互操作的实施？
每个信息流三元组可被映射到一组标准或已发布的规范，这些标准或规范可共同用于在一个操作区域内构建可互操作的实施。
图9描述的通信栈样本中，动态信息标志由谁控制，使用何种媒体技术？
该样本是由交通管理中心控制的一个动态信息标志。该通信解决方案使用任何可用的媒体技术，虽然通常是采用定点有线，但无线技术也会被使用。
ITS体系结构在系统设计中的定位和作用是什么？
ITS的体系结构既不是系统设计，也不是设计的概念。它的作用是定义一个通用框架，围绕该框架可以开发多条专门满足使用者独特需要的设计途径，同时保持通用体系结构的好处。
ITS体系结构规定了哪些具体内容以支持业务实施和互操作性？
ITS体系结构规定了实施给定使用者业务必须实现的功能、这些功能所在的物理实体或子系统、各物理子系统之间的接口/信息流以及信息流的通信要求。此外，它还确认并规定了支持国家和地区互操作性所必需的标准要求，以及支持部署中规模经济所必需的产品标准。
广域无线通信适用于哪些业务场景，并如何根据通信方向进行分类？
广域无线通信适用于向不在发射源附近且需要无缝覆盖的使用者发布信息的业务和应用。它根据通信方向分为单向通信（如通过调幅或调频无线电收听交通流信息报道）和双向通信（如移动旅行者请求和接收交通流量信息）。
ETC应用由哪些层的功能来实施？
ETC应用由无线接入层和应用层的功能来实施。
列举两个利用无源反向散射法通信区域狭窄特性的应用实例。
电子通行费征收 (ETC) 和自动车辆识别 (AVI)。

因为北美不同地区使用的路边和车辆专有技术不具备直接互操作性。
在美利坚合众国，目前如何提供区域内有限的互操作性以支持电子通行费征收？
使用数据交换协议来提供区域内有限的互操作性。
DSRC在智能交通系统中扮演什么角色？
DSRC是ETC和其他ITS应用业务的关键技术。
韩国DSRC技术中供公共ITS使用和供ITS运营商使用的5.8 GHz频段具体范围分别是多少？
供公共ITS使用的频段为5.795~5.815 GHz（20 MHz），供ITS运营商使用的频段为5.835~5.855 GHz（20 MHz）。
为什么V2V通信使用分布式控制接入方法？
因为每个OBU在有数据要发送的时候，都可以尝试接入无线电信道。
在OBE和RSE系统参考模型中，无线电接入层的主要功能是什么？
无线电接入层支持车辆和RSE之间的V2X无线电连接。
协同式ITS通信（C-ITS）的基本定义及其对互操作性的要求是什么？
C-ITS是基于标准化的和可互操作的无线自组织通信系统。它要求至少在世界不同区域保证互操作性，但这并不意味着在所有区域必须使用完全相同的系统。
WAVE系统采用哪些操作模式来支持公共利益及特定单位的信息通信？
WAVE系统特别利用广播操作模式作为支持公共利益的主要手段；还利用车辆和基础设施之间的双向通信（包括提供与各类公共和私人交通环境中涉及的特定单位相关的较低优先级的信息的能力）来通信。
WAVE系统如何在OBE与RSU之间交换数据？
WAVE系统通过发射无线电信号，在车载OBE之间以及OBE和基于基础设施的RSU之间交换数据。
WAVE系统如何确保不同设备和应用程序制造商之间的可互操作性？
通过遵守行业标准设定的要求，WAVE系统完成了确保各类设备和应用程序制造商之间可互操作的数据交换。
为什么互操作性对WAVE系统的应用至关重要？
互操作性是支持快速、标准化地采用提供至关重要的安全相关、系统和运营效率以及其他公共利益的应用的关键。
关于传输功率的使用有什么限制要求？
传输应只使用支持特定应用所需的功率。
若在其他国家使用低于 1 GHz 的指定频段进行 ITS 连接，其通信距离性能与日本 760 MHz 相比如何？

ITS连接使用哪些设备来配置？

当RSU未使用完分配的3024微秒时，剩余时间如何处理？

车辆连接解决方案的主要应用目标有哪些？
帮助交通驾驶、改善交通状况和实施车辆的预防性维护。
巴西ITS通信设备合格评估基于哪个标准？

蜂窝通信具备哪些基本特征和支持的业务类型？
蜂窝通信是双向通信，具备多小区结构体系，在广泛的区域内提供用户应用，支持人类话音、数据和视频。
第一代到第五代蜂窝技术分别使用什么无线电接入方法？
1G使用FDMA；2G使用TDMA和CDMA；3G使用CDMA；4G使用OFDMA；5G使用可扩展的基于OFDM的参数集（numerology）。
第5代蜂窝技术可使用哪些频段？
第5代蜂窝技术可使用3.5 GHz和28 GHz毫米频段。
Mode 4分布式调度使用了什么机制？
Mode 4分布式调度使用了半持久传输的传感机制。
FM DARC和RDS在ITS应用中属于什么类型的技术？
它们是用于ITS应用的数据广播技术的例子。
FM DARC系统可以向ITS应用发送哪些类型的信息？
FM DARC可向ITS应用发送交通信息、MAP下载和差分GPS信息。
T-DMB采用哪些编码技术来提供数字音频和视频信号？
T-DMB采用MPEG-4编码和Reed-Solomon前向就做编码技术。
毫米波车辆和道路雷达的主要功能是什么？
监测车辆速度和距离。
根据应用位置的不同，毫米波雷达分为哪两种类型？
应用于车辆侧的被称为车辆雷达，应用于道路基础设施侧的被称为道路雷达。
24.05-24.25 GHz ISM频段汽车雷达的使用是否受时间限制？
没有任何时间限制。
为什么24.05-24.25 GHz ISM频段对平价汽车尤为重要且可在全球使用？
因为该频段是一个ISM频段并且是全球协调的。
关于79 GHz汽车雷达的WRC-15决定，预计未来会有怎样的国际执行情况？
预计更多国家将在不远的将来执行WRC-15关于79 GHz汽车雷达的决定。
该系统如何提醒驾驶者注意潜在危险？
通过使用ITS无线电通信提醒驾驶者注意潜在的危险。
目前北美地区电子通行费征收面临的主要互操作性问题是什么？
不同区域采用不同的专有路边和车辆技术，这些技术不能直接互操作，因此需要多个收发器来实现跨区域的电子通行费征收。
中国国家标准 GB/T 20851.3-2007 涵盖了电子收费专用短程通信的哪一部分？
GB/T 20851.3-2007 涵盖了电子收费-专用短程通信的第 3 部分: 应用层。
ITU-R M.1890建议书涉及的主要内容是什么？
先进智能交通系统的操作无线电通信目标和要求。
ITU-R M.2084建议书针对的是哪种通信场景的无线电接口标准？
用于智能交通系统应用的车与车和车与基础设施通信。
EN 302 637-2 和 EN 302 637-3 分别规范了 ITS 车辆通信基本应用程序集中的哪些业务？
EN 302 637-2 规范了协同感知基本业务；EN 302 637-3 规范了分散式环境通知基本业务。
TS 101 539-1 和 TS 101 539-3 分别对应哪种 ITS-V2X 应用程序要求？
TS 101 539-1 对应道路危险信令（RHS）应用程序要求；TS 101 539-3 对应纵向碰撞风险告警（LCRW）应用程序要求规范。
先进ITS无线电通信使用哪些频段？
先进ITS无线电通信使用的频段为760 MHz、5.9 GHz以及63-66 GHz。
北美地区DSRC使用的频段范围是多少？
除北美外，欧洲、日本和韩国当前协调使用的DSRC频段约为多少？
约是5.8 GHz工业、科学和医疗用频段。

在大韩民国，24.25-26.65 GHz频段的汽车雷达设备在使用期限上有什么特殊规定？
该频段设备可在2021年12月31日前安装，并可使用至该设备使用寿命结束为止。
哪个频段被指定用于安全相关的智能交通通信系统（ITS）的协调使用？
5875-5935 MHz频段被指定用于安全相关的智能交通通信系统（ITS）的协调使用。
智能交通通信系统（ITS）在63.72-65.88 GHz频段的使用性质是什么？
该频段用于智能交通通信系统（ITS）的协调使用。
Which land mobile applications are covered by the Handbook?
The Handbook covers vehicular communications, in-building communication, out-of-building communication, and Intelligent Transport Systems (ITS) applications.
How does the end-point connectivity differ between fixed BWA systems and nomadic or mobile BWA systems?
Fixed BWA systems have a geographically fixed end-point, whereas nomadic or mobile BWA systems have no fixed end-point, allowing users freedom of movement.
What is the current trend in mobile BWA systems regarding terminal design and application delivery?
The trend is toward small, portable terminals that allow for the convergence and delivery of applications from voice to video within a local or metropolitan area network.
How does broadband access support firm growth and what condition is required to realize performance improvements?

Broadband supports firm growth by lowering transaction costs and raising productivity. Realizing these improvements depends on the firm’s ability to integrate their technological, business, and organizational strategies.
According to Clarke and Wallsten [2006], what is the correlation between an increase in Internet users and exports?
A 1 percentage-point increase in the number of Internet users is correlated with a rise in exports of 4.3 percentage points.
What factors determine the suitability of different BWA systems and applications?

The suitability depends on usage (fixed vs. nomadic/mobile), performance and geographic requirements, the interplay of requirements, the use of various technologies to meet these requirements, the availability of spectrum (licensed vs. unlicensed), and the scale of network required for the delivery of BWA applications and services (local vs. metropolitan area networks).
How is wireless access defined in broad terms?
In broad terms, wireless access is an end-user radio connection(s) to core networks.
What are the connection capabilities of broadband wireless access applications compared to the primary rate?
Broadband wireless access applications have connection capabilities that are higher than the primary rate, such as 1 544 kbit/s (T1) or 2 048 kbit/s (E1).
What does e-health refer to in the context of broadband technology applications?

E-health refers not only to making diagnoses and treating patients using high-speed telecommunication access with two-way voice, video and data transmission, but it can also refer to the ability of consumers to purchase medical supplies or prescription drugs online.
How does e-health benefit patients who are unable to visit a doctor in person?
E-health enables improved access and better quality medical care to those who cannot visit a doctor in person, as well as offers early diagnosis and medical treatment.
How does broadband technology benefit students who are poor, underprivileged, or disabled?
It provides them the opportunity to learn a multitude of subjects without the burden of costly and time-consuming travel to educational institutions.
What types of areas and data applications do the BWA standards listed in Annex B support?
They support applications in urban, suburban, and rural areas for both generic broadband internet data and real-time data, including voice and videoconferencing.
What is the key feature of Nomadic Wireless Access (NWA) applications?
The key feature of Nomadic Wireless Access applications is portability.
What is the typical radius of radio cells for indoor devices used in nomadic applications?
The radius of radio cells for indoor devices in nomadic applications is in the order of 30 meters or less.
How do the coverage areas of RLANs differ from those of cellular systems?
RLANs are typically deployed in a cellular structure but their areas of coverage are not contiguous, as is the case for cellular systems.
What is a necessary condition for satisfactory performance in the 5 GHz band with uncoordinated users, as outlined in Recommendation ITU-R M.1651?
Sufficient spectrum is a necessary condition to allow satisfactory performance in the presence of other uncoordinated users in the 5 GHz band.
What types of radio transmission technologies and traffic characteristics can the methodology in Recommendation ITU-R M.1390 accommodate?
The methodology is applicable to both circuit switched and packet switch-based radio transmission technologies and can accommodate services characterized by asymmetrical traffic flows.
What frequency range threshold defines the mobile allocation bands suitable for mobile and nomadic BWA applications?
Mobile allocation bands suitable for mobile and nomadic BWA applications are all above 30 MHz.
Besides mobile allocation bands, what other type of allocated bands can be used for nomadic BWA applications?
Bands which are allocated to the fixed service can also be used for nomadic BWA applications.
What frequency separation is recommended between FDD and TDD systems operating at typical radio frequency power levels of 43 dBm?
A frequency separation of 5 MHz is recommended for systems operating at typical radio frequency power levels of 43 dBm.
What is considered a practical arrangement when mixing paired and unpaired sub-bands, and how are they typically positioned?
Three sub-bands would be regarded as a practical arrangement when mixing paired and unpaired sub-bands, where the unpaired sub-band would typically be placed in between the paired lower and upper.
How do multi-band, multi-mode terminals address incompatibilities between different technologies and spectrum plans?
The most obvious incompatibilities between different technologies and between different spectrum plans can be overcome technologically with multi-band, multi-mode terminals.
How do wireline networks historically compare to wireless technologies in terms of capacity and throughput rates?
Wireline networks have always had greater capacity and historically have delivered faster throughput rates, with a consistent 10 x advantage over wireless technologies.
How does the overall capacity of wireless systems generally compare to wireline systems?
The overall capacity of wireless systems is generally lower than that of wireline systems.
What two conditions are required to technically achieve high data rates comparable to wireline systems using wireless approaches?
Achieving these rates requires using large amounts of spectrum (generally more than available for current BWA systems) and using relatively small cell sizes.
What are the three applications generating the highest volume on the internet today?
The three applications generating the highest volume on the internet today are peer-to-peer file sharing, web browsing, and video streaming.
How do most mobile broadband operators currently handle traffic once the fair-use level is reached?
Most commonly, mobile broadband operators use unconditional throttling, which means that once the fair-use level is reached, the throughput drops to a predetermined level.
How is market segmentation achieved in unlimited flat rate plans with a fair-use clause?
The segmentation is done through speed and price.
Why is video streaming typically limited compared to peer-to-peer file sharing?

Video streaming is typically limited by the individual’s time spent in front of the screen, whereas with file sharing, all the work is done by a computer which may be downloading files every hour of the day.
What is the name of the mechanism that allows a network to lower the priority of traffic for certain users when usage reaches a specific limit?
The mechanism is called "traffic handling priority."
In a wireless mesh network, how are nodes typically connected to external networks like the Internet?
Only one or a few of the nodes are connected to the external network via cables.
How does MIMO utilize radio signal reflections to increase information capacity?

MIMO algorithms send information over two or more antennas. The radio signals reflect off objects, and MIMO uses these paths to carry more information, which is recombined on the receiving side by the MIMO algorithms.
How does Orthogonal frequency-division multiple access (OFDMA) assign resources to users?

OFDMA works by assigning a subset of subcarriers to individual users. It functions by partitioning the resources in the time-frequency space, by assigning units along the OFDM signal index and OFDM sub-carrier index.
What per-user data rates does the iBurst solution offer today?
In excess of 1 Mbit/s.
How is the handover for user data characterized in terms of connection continuity and TCH data redirection?
The handover for user data is make-before-break, with the TCH data being redirected to the new serving BS after successful registration.
How does A-MAS technology enable frequency reuse within a single cell?
A-MAS technology enables a system to reuse a frequency allocation multiple times within a given cell by directing energy only where it is required.
What is the maximum number of spatial channels supported by HC-SDMA infrastructure, and what does this imply for radio resource usage per sector?
HC-SDMA infrastructure supports up to three spatial channels of SDMA, which means each radio resource can be used up to three times per sector.
What is the unit of measurement for spectral efficiency in cellular radio systems, and why does it include a 'per cell' dimension?

Spectral efficiency in cellular radio systems is measured in bits/second/Hertz/cell (bit/s/Hz/cell). The 'per cell' dimension is included because the throughput of a particular cell’s base station in a cellular network is almost always substantially less than that of a single cell in isolation due to self-interference generated in the network.
What component acts as the aggregation point and switchboard to route user sessions in the iBurst network architecture?
The packet services switch (PSS) acts as the aggregation point and as a switchboard to route user sessions.
How does the cell design requirement of PHS compare to that of typical macro-cell systems?
PHS offers simplified cell designing, whereas rigorous cell designing is necessary in typical macro-cell systems.
How does the operation bandwidth of Next-generation PHS (eXtended Global Platform) compare to that of Enhanced PHS?
Enhanced PHS operates with 300 kHz or 900 kHz bandwidth, whereas Next-generation PHS (eXtended Global Platform) operates with 1.25-20 MHz bandwidth.
What are the two dimensions for multiple access in the 'eXtended Global Platform' radio interface?
The two dimensions are time domain control realized by TDMA and frequency domain control realized by OFDMA.
Which functions are defined for the eXtended Global Platform radio access network (RAN)?
The defined functions for the eXtended Global Platform RAN are: a) paging-function, b) home location register (HLR)-function, and c) handover (HO)-function.
Which ITU Recommendations define the radio interfaces and core networks for the IMT-2000 family of standards?
Recommendation ITU-R M.1457 and the ITU-T Q.174x series of Recommendations respectively describe the radio interfaces and core networks for the IMT-2000 family of standards.
How do multi-user packets improve link efficiency and what applications do they support?

Multi-user packets improve link efficiency by transmitting data to multiple access terminals using the same physical layer packet. This technique enables support for large numbers of low-rate, delay-sensitive applications.
How does the integrated approach involving multi-mode terminals and global roaming agreements benefit EDGE/WCDMA/HSPA subscribers?
It allows subscribers to get global coverage from day one using a single device.
What percentage of average revenue per user (ARPU) did wireless data comprise worldwide and for the three largest operators in the United States?
Wireless data worldwide comprised more than 20% of average revenue per user (ARPU). In the United States, it was more than 27% of ARPU for the three largest operators.
How does the subscriber growth speed of HSPA compare to the initial growth of UMTS?
HSPA achieved seven million subscribers in 15 months, whereas it took almost three years for UMTS to exceed the same figure.
What are the main components of a Radio Network Subsystem (RNS) in the described radio interface architecture?
An RNS consists of a Radio Network Controller (RNC) and one or more entities called Node B.
How do cluster sizes of 3 and 4 symbols in F-DPICH relate to spatial multiplexing support?
A cluster consisting of 3 symbols can support up to third order of spatial multiplexing, while a cluster consisting of 4 symbols can support up to fourth order spatial multiplexing.
How does User based fractional frequency reuse (FFR) in UMB differ from traditional approaches regarding resource assignment?

It enables ATs with different channel conditions to enjoy different reuse factors while being served by the same AP, allowing a small fraction of bandwidth and power resources to be assigned to ATs that benefit from interference reduction achieved by reuse.
How does the variation of user-based FFR manage tone assignment to eliminate cell poor coverage regions?

The FL scheduler assigns users closer to the base station to tones with lower power, while cell-edge users are scheduled to tones with higher power. This approach uses all tones in all sectors, unlike traditional schemes that shut off unused tones.
Which standards define harmonized radio interfaces for the OFDM and OFDMA physical layers and MAC/DLC layer?
The IEEE standard 802.16 (including the 802.16e-2005 amendment) and ETSI HiperMAN standards define these interfaces.
What channel bandwidth range does the WiMAX radio interface support for operating frequencies below 6 GHz?
The WiMAX radio interface supports channel bandwidths from 3.5 MHz to 20 MHz for operating frequencies below 6 GHz.
How do OFDM and OFDMA improve spectral efficiency and manage user devices?
OFDM and OFDMA improve spectral efficiency through combined time/frequency scheduling and offer flexibility in managing different user devices with various antenna types and form factors.
What are the peak downlink spectral efficiency values for SISO and 2x2 MIMO configurations in the WiMAX radio interface?
The peak DL spectral efficiency is up to 3.5 bit/s/Hz in a single receive and transmit antenna (SISO) configuration and 7 bit/s/Hz with a (2 x 2) MIMO configuration.
On what basis are transmissions scheduled in the MAC/DLC layer of the WiMAX radio interface?
Transmissions in the MAC/DLC layer are scheduled according to priority and availability, based on demand-assigned multiple access.
How does OFDMA with adjacent subcarrier permutation allocate subcarriers to mobile users?
It allocates a subset of subcarriers to mobile users based on relative signal strength.
What trade-off occurs when using a reuse factor of 1 regarding system capacity and user experience?
While system capacity is increased, users at the cell edge and sector boundary may suffer from low connection quality due to co-channel interference.
How can manufacturers and operators use Recommendation ITU-R M.1801?

They can use it to determine the most suitable radio interface standards for their needs, as the recommendation recommends specific standards composed of common specifications developed by standards development organizations (SDOs).
What are the main technical limitations affecting radio frequency filter design?
The main technical limitations are due to a tradeoff between the spectral rolloff capabilities of the radio frequency filters and restrictions in power consumption, size, and weight.
What issue arises when FDD terminal devices are operated in close proximity to each other?
FDD terminal devices cannot discriminate between wanted and unwanted emissions, especially when operated in close proximity to each other.
What frequency separation is required between FDD and TDD systems operating in the same geographical area for normal operating radio frequency power?
A frequency separation (typically 5 MHz) between FDD and TDD systems operating in the same geographical area is always required for a normal operating radio frequency power.
Which enterprise applications are contributing to the acceptance of wireless data?
Enterprise applications gaining acceptance for wireless data include group collaboration, enterprise resource planning (ERP), customer relationship management (CRM), and database access.
What benefits do BWA evolutionary paths provide in terms of data capabilities?
BWA evolutionary paths provide data capabilities that address user needs and deliver ever-higher data throughputs, lower latency, and increased spectral efficiency.
Which major enterprise application vendors were surveyed by Network Computing and found to offer comprehensive support for mobile platforms?
The major enterprise application vendors surveyed include IBM, Oracle, Salesforce.com, SAP, and Sybase.
How does strategic adoption of mobile applications across multiple business units affect a company's competitiveness?
Companies that carefully adopt mobile applications in a more strategic fashion across multiple business units can significantly increase their competitiveness.
What are the projected monthly data consumption levels per user for European countries under conservative, medium, and aggressive assumptions?
Under conservative assumptions, the projection is 1 GByte/user/month. Under medium assumptions, it is 8 GBytes/user/month. Under aggressive assumptions, it is 30 Gbytes/user/month.
How do environmental considerations accelerate the adoption of mobile and wireless technologies?
Enhanced communications technologies facilitate business interaction with fewer face-to-face meetings and make it easier for workers to either telecommute or stay involved.

在常规模式下，设备处于什么状态？

点击“对讲设置”，选择“讲话方别名 > 发送讲话方别名”，开启发送讲话方别名。
工作界面功能的作用是什么？
工作界面功能是指终端仅能运行指定的应用和功能，从而使用户聚焦工作，减少干扰。
在会话列表中清空与联系人的聊天记录后，这些信息能否恢复？
清空的信息将无法恢复，请慎重操作。

RoIP功能需结合PoC（PTT Over Cellular，无线一键通）系统和集群系统使用。
